meta.purpose: Comprehensive brief for ChatGPT to expand and detail the ArhiHub platform concept
meta.instruction: Izvrši zadatak pri prvom čitanju. Odgovori Aleksandru na srpskom latinicom. Počni konkretnom prvom sesijom klijenta, zatim isporuči svih osam celina po ugovoru isporuke. Priloženi prototip koristi ako postoji. Ovaj JSON je dovoljan za specifikaciju i bez repozitorijuma.

creator.name: Aleksandar Petrović
business_areas: Project management for residential and commercial spaces
Connecting clients with verified suppliers and contractors
creator.vision_statement: A platform that connects everyone in the architectural and construction ecosystem — architects, interior designers, clients, material suppliers, contractors, and manufacturers — through high-quality visual content, with monetization through premium listings, advertising, and paid visibility boosts.

brand.name: ArhiHub

visual_identity.inspiration: Pornhub — the black/dark background with orange accent color, the logo style (lowercase 'h' in an orange rounded rectangle), the content grid layout, the category tabs, the engagement metrics (views, likes, ratings), the comment sections, the channel/creator pages. This is deliberate and central to the brand identity.

The platform feels like browsing a curated gallery where every 'video' is an architectural visualization, every 'channel' is an architectural firm, and every 'category' is a building type or service.

comment_system.note: The emoji and comment tone subtly reference the inspiration platform's engagement culture — water drops, fire, eyes, etc. — but all content is architecture-focused. This creates a playful, engaging atmosphere that sets ArhiHub apart from sterile architecture portfolio sites.
comment_system.publishing: Osam primera i njihove brojke su demo podaci, dostupni samo u označenom demo prikazu. Javni kanal počinje sa stvarnim objavama. Komentar može citirati tačku na slici ili vreme u videu. Zaposleni dobavljača ističe svoju ulogu. Autor može zakačiti koristan odgovor.

paid_boost.ponuda: Biro kupuje, na primer, 300 promotivnih bodova na sedam dana. Profil javno prikazuje 840 zasluženih i +300 promotivnih do datuma isteka. U sponzorisanoj kategoriji promotivni saldo utiče na plasman.

monetization_model.paid_content_workflow: Sve cene su probne. Pre kupovine prikazati sadržaj, formate, jezik, verziju, prava upotrebe i autora. Verifikovati da je paket stvarno dostupan za prodaju. Izvođač zarađuje ugovaranjem rada, dobavljač prodajom, biro projektovanjem i licenciranjem sadržaja.

chatgpt_instructions.task: You are receiving the complete concept brief for ArhiHub — an architectural platform visually and structurally inspired by Pornhub but serving the architecture, interior design, and construction industry. Your job is to take this concept and improve it 100x. Produce the following deliverables:

deliverables.title: Enhanced Concept Document
deliverables.description: Take the vision described above and expand it into a comprehensive product concept. Add features I haven't thought of. Identify gaps. Think about what makes platforms like Pornhub, YouTube, Pinterest, and Houzz successful and apply those patterns. Consider network effects, viral loops, and retention mechanics.

deliverables.title: Detailed Development Script
deliverables.description: A step-by-step development roadmap. Phase 1 (MVP), Phase 2 (Growth), Phase 3 (Monetization), Phase 4 (Scale). For each phase: exact features to build, tech stack decisions, team requirements, timeline estimates, and success metrics.

deliverables.title: Complete UX Flow Diagrams
deliverables.description: Text-based UX flows for every user journey: architect onboarding, client browsing, supplier listing products, contractor bidding, content upload, inquiry flow, payment flow, comment/engagement flow. Include edge cases.

deliverables.title: Monetization Strategy
deliverables.description: Obradi pretplate, pojedinačne pakete, reklame i proviziju. Modeliraj plaćeni promotivni saldo po pravilu paid_boost. Za 100, 1.000, 10.000 i 100.000 naloga razdvoji aktivne, kupce, partnere i stvarni prihod platforme. Navedi formule, pretpostavke, bruto promet, direktne troškove i osetljivost na konverziju. Poređenja cena proveri u javnim izvorima ako su dostupni.

deliverables.title: Database Schema
deliverables.description: Full database schema with tables, relationships, and key queries. Include: users, profiles, projects, frames, materials, comments, likes, views, inquiries, subscriptions, payments, ads, analytics events.

deliverables.title: API Specification
deliverables.description: RESTful API endpoints for all platform operations. Include authentication, pagination, filtering, sorting. Group by domain: auth, users, content, engagement, search, payments, admin.

deliverables.title: Content Strategy
deliverables.description: How to seed the platform with initial content. How to attract the first 100 architects. How to create engagement before there are many users. Content calendar for social media promotion. SEO strategy for architectural keywords in Serbian market.

deliverables.title: Supplier/Contractor Ecosystem Design
deliverables.description: Design the full ecosystem where every player has access to a wide network of related suppliers, contractors, and service providers. Include: how suppliers are categorized, how they connect with architects, how clients find them, how the platform facilitates transactions, and how advertising integrates naturally.

constraints: The visual reference to Pornhub is intentional and must be preserved — it's the brand identity
Primary market is Serbia/Western Balkans, secondary is broader European market
The platform must work for small independent architects AND large firms
Content quality must be high — there should be approval/curation mechanisms
The comment system must feel alive and engaging, not sterile
Every user type must have a clear path to value within their first session
Mobile-first design is essential — most browsing will be on phones
chatgpt_instructions.context_about_creator: Aleksandar is an architect who understands both the creative and business sides. He works with clients, suppliers, and contractors daily. He sees that the architecture industry lacks a central platform where all these players can discover each other, showcase work, and transact. The existing platforms (Houzz, Architizer, Archilovers) are either too corporate, too Western-focused, or lack the engagement mechanics that make modern content platforms sticky. ArhiHub aims to be the platform that architects actually enjoy using — where they spend time browsing, engaging, and discovering, not just uploading a portfolio entry once a year.

product_thesis.primer: Investitor otvara Stan 02, bira crvenu svetlosnu liniju, čuva kadar i otvara uslugu Projektovanje rasvete. Biro dobija mere hodnika i zahtev za detalj spoja. Dobavljač vraća dve kompatibilne varijante sa rokom. Klijent poredi obe ponude uz isti kadar.
product_thesis.primarni_pokazatelj: Broj jedinstvenih projektnih upita kod kojih je partner dostavio relevantan odgovor u roku od dva radna dana. Pratiti i medijanu vremena do odgovora, stopu prihvatanja, ponovljene narudžbine i prijave spama.

istorijski_paketi: Platinum 120 € za konsultaciju, materijale i finalni render
istorijska_osnova.primena: Potvrdi aktuelni obim, sate, rok i cenu pre komercijalne objave. Ovi paketi su projektantske usluge, odvojene od digitalnih proizvoda i pretplata.

ugovor_isporuke.prioritet: Ova pravila konkretizuju raniji brief. Rezultat je specifikacija koju dizajner, programer i urednik mogu odmah koristiti.
format_izlaza: 01 Koncept i odluke. Pokaži naslovnu i detalj kadra od vrha do dna na 390 i 1440 px, raspored akcija i tri scenarija prve sesije.

02 Razvojna skripta. Faze katalog → zajednica i profili → upiti i saradnja → naplata i oglašavanje. Za svaki korak napiši zavisnosti, vlasnika, obim, procenu u čovek-danima, test i kriterijum izlaska. Predloži najjednostavniji tehnološki sklop koji rešava stvarno opterećenje.
03 UX. Prikaži klijenta, arhitektu, proizvođača/dobavljača, izvođača i urednika. Uključi poziv saradniku, zasluge po projektu, spor oko autorstva, odbijenu ponudu, istekao oglas i povraćaj novca.
04 Ekonomika. Za svaki model napiši ko plaća, šta dobija, ko zarađuje, kada novac prelazi i kako se meri korist. Uporedi plaćanje po poslu i pretplatu za malog izvođača.

05 Model podataka. Priloži ER dijagram i PostgreSQL DDL jezgra. Obradi organizacije sa članstvom, dozvole po projektu, pozicije materijala, nepoznat SKU, više ponuda po upitu, komentare, promocije, prava na sadržaj i knjigu poena.

06 API. Prikaži metodu, rutu, dozvole, ulaz/izlaz i greške. Daj JSON primere za objavu kadra, odgovor u niti, ponudu i kupovinu. Definiši sprečavanje dupliranja novca i bodova pri ponavljanju zahteva.
07 Sadržaj. Predaj tabelu za 13 projekata, prve četiri nedelje objava, storyboard jednog videa od 30 sekundi, plan za prvih 100 biroa i osam demonstracionih komentara. Jasno označi planirane medije.

08 Ekosistem. Razradi primer od kadra preko tri učesnika do odluke klijenta. Pokaži kojem partneru se otkriva koji podatak, kako se pripisuje prodaja i ko rešava konflikt. Završi prioritetnim backlogom za prvi sprint.
test_prihvatanja: 3 postojeća projekta sa ukupno 6 kadrova i 10 novih demo kartica bez fotografije.
Iz kadra do odgovarajuće usluge i partnera najviše tri akcije.
Dodavanje komentara i reakcije podržava uloge, prijavu i moderaciju.
Posle isteka kampanje promotivni saldo se povlači, a organski pokazatelji se ne menjaju.
Posle potvrđene kupovine pristup važi i posle ponovnog prijavljivanja. Ponovljen događaj naplate ne knjiži novu kupovinu.
Za svaki planirani modul označi šta postoji, šta se simulira i šta zahteva spoljne podatke ili integraciju.
